extra.message: User-controlled request path is formatted directly into a string template which is rendered via render_template_string in the 404 handler. This allows attackers to perform Server-side Template Injection (SSTI) and achieve remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: User input from the 'search' parameter is directly formatted into a raw SQL clause within the text() construct, enabling SQL injection.

cwe: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

extra.message: The /accounts/<user_id>/notes endpoint allows any authenticated user to fetch the personal notes of any other user via IDOR since there is no authorization check validating the owner of the requested notes.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: The /account POST handler does not require authentication and maps form data directly to user model attributes via __dict__.update(). Any user can submit a POST request containing 'is_admin' to elevate their privilege to administrator (mass assignment).

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: The application deserializes the 'preferences' cookie using pickle.loads() directly from base64-decoded user input without any validation, allowing arbitrary remote code execution.

The download() utility downloads an image URL using urllib.request.urlopen without validating the scheme or hostname, leading to Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) and Local File Read (via file:// protocol schemes).

The registration code input is directly formatted into a SQL query executed with session.execute(text(...)) during token validation. This allows SQL injection and bypass of the registration code validation check.

cwe: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

extra.message: The delete_note endpoint accepts a note_id and deletes the record from the database without verifying if the note belongs to the currently logged in user, leading to Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR).
The 'text' field of personal notes is marked as a safe_column when rendering search results tables without input or output sanitization, causing Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: The 'text' field of personal notes is marked as a safe_column when rendering user notes without input or output sanitization, leading to Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: A hardcoded, predictable secret key 'super secret key' is configured for the Flask session, making it trivial for an attacker to decrypt or forge session tokens.
